readerPresentationReview.scope: First-read chapter threads, key-term navigation, progressive disclosure, and clearly labelled hypothetical worked examples. This revision adds a longer beginner materials path and a distinct advanced follow-up using existing governed modules and claim IDs.

latestRevision.conclusion: Expanded the beginner polymer and exact-grade introductions and added one non-numeric material-comparison example. Added one explicitly hypothetical worked example to each advanced materials module. Split fibre orientation and high-performance polymers into an advanced follow-up immediately after the beginner chapter; every governed module remains present exactly once and no claim IDs or process recipes were added.
latestRevision.rationale: The beginner chapter now explains the chain analogy and exact-grade identity in more detail, then walks through a fair comparison without relying on property values detached from their conditions. The follow-up uses hypothetical examples to apply existing evidence about directional fibre behaviour and exact-grade/system compatibility. These additions remain within the existing module claim scopes. The word counts are source-derived editorial information, not proof of learner comprehension or engineering approval.
latestRevision.materialChapterEmphasis: r03 now gives a longer first-read explanation of polymer chains, family names, exact grades and a worked comparison. r03a follows immediately with advanced fibre-orientation and high-performance-polymer applications. r18 and r19 retain dimensional-stability and thin-wall/multi-cavity material without repeating the moved modules.
